numerical_evidence.scope: Class means and independent held-out decision
numerical_evidence.reference: Six training rows give class 1 mean (2,2/3), class 3 mean (7,2/3). The boundary is nir=4.5; every tested point has a unique nearest mean. Training outlier (6,0) belongs to class1 but predicts class3, distinguishing nearest mean from 1-nearest training observation. Independent NumPy means/distances agree.

Training 4x4 matrix contains gaps at labels0/2, row1 has counts2 at predicted1 and1 at predicted3, row3 count3 at predicted3; training accuracy5/6 (kappa2/3 by hand). Held-out predictions [1,3,3,1,3], order[3,1] matrix[[2,1],[1,1]], accuracy3/5, kappa1/6. A separate five-row test fixture verifies asymmetric non-perfect training and held-out matrices using independently computed mean distances.

tolerance.scope: Finite Float64 accuracy/Kappa ratios against independent integer references; label counts exact

limits: Only Classifier.minimumDistance/train/schema/setOutputMode(CLASSIFICATION)/confusionMatrix and inline FeatureCollection.classify; not whole Classifier class support

Exact Fraction arithmetic represents finite binary64 inputs, means and squared distances; bounded rational arithmetic is a local numerical policy, not verified Smile/Google accumulation rounding. Equal-distance nearest classes explicitly reject rather than choosing a tie
Inline prediction<=1000 features, complete numeric trained schema; outputName nonempty flat and absent from input properties. Overwriting existing output properties is unsupported
Immutable model survives typed If/Dictionary.get; direct/nested model JSON, Feature property model storage and model truth coercion reject. Public server-object schema is not fabricated
